evidence: Source token at AM-132-fol-Egils-saga 63r:30 is surface nótt, lemma nátt, in an ordinary temporal travel expression; both nátt and nótt map to the night lexeme.

Current Norse table maps nótt correctly to pie-lex-nokwts. Kaikki *nahts and nǫ́tt support night. Lexicon attaches this word to negw-bare with an uncertain etymon part; the published analysis of *negʷ- is disputed (Pooth 2015; Kloekhorst 2014 p.161; NIL pp.504–505,510–511). This is not sufficient to declare the Norse lexical mapping erroneous.
